(1) BLOCKER-1: grep "validation_routes." src/main.zig returns 1 hit at line 772 inside the POST /validate branch (src/main.zig:762-773); handleValidate is invoked with (def_store, req_alloc, validate_tenant, seg4) where validate_tenant is resolved from authenticated_ctx.tenant_id (with DEFAULT_TENANT_ID fallback). Defence in depth: process_definitions has FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY with tenant_id = bpm_effective_tenant_id() predicate (migrations/028_adp02_tenant_scope_persistence.sql), and the ambient context assertion in the handler closes the gap if a future refactor caches/reuses connections across tenant boundaries. INV-3, INV-4, INV-6, INV-8 are not applicable to this diff (no new Lua/Wasm host APIs, no secret material, no new catch unreachable on realistic failure paths).
